# Fetch all pending received payment requests (paginate)
access_token = login_response["access_token"]
all_requests = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(access_token=access_token, status="pending", page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    all_requests.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
print(f"Total pending requests fetched: {len(all_requests)}")
